d:
One of the most heartbreaking Punjabi songs ever made Qismat by Ammy Virk — out now on Speed Records.
With soul-stirring lyrics by Jaani and music by B Praak, Qismat became an all-time favourite — a song about changing fate and lost love that struck a chord with millions. Starring Ammy Virk & Sargun Mehta, directed by Arvindr Khaira. Feel every word.
